option_relations.rationale: Bronchiolitis obliterans is a distinct disease of the small airways, not directly related to Chronic Pulmonary Tuberculosis.
Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is a separate chronic inflammatory lung disease, not directly related to Chronic Pulmonary Tuberculosis.
Bronchiectasis is a condition of permanent enlargement of parts of the airways, not directly related to Chronic Pulmonary Tuberculosis.
Diffuse panbronchiolitis (DPB) is a distinct inflammatory disease primarily affecting the respiratory bronchioles, not directly related to Chronic Pulmonary Tuberculosis.
